race.comment: DREAMERS NEVER DIE (4) went back to 1100m last start and was disappointing as the favourite. Back out to 1200m now is a big tick for him after just missing two back in a photo. Fiore sticks and he can land the knockout bllow this time around. MILITARY ACTION (8) settled midfield and got over the top to score at 1400m last time out. Staples rides now and she has a good record aboard the gelding who is racing in top order at the moment. Comes here off a freshen and can play a leading role. SCIENCE DEGREE (1) booted up from the inside draw to lead last start and was there on straightening before being claimed and finishing a head away in second over 1100m at this track. Sure to give a sight. THE LIONS' GATE (5) is better than he's shown his past couple where he's been left with too much to do. Can bounce back to form today. DANCEWITHME (10) is better than she showed last time out and won't be far away.
